_comments.id: Descriptive transformer/area ID; runtime transformer indexes follow top-level JSON order.
_comments.bus_id: Physical grid bus from the NODES column. It must exist and cannot be the slack bus.
_comments.max_power: Maximum aggregate transformer power in kW.
_comments.charging_stations: Every station nested here is connected to this transformer and bus.

_comments.id: Descriptive station ID; runtime station IDs are assigned sequentially.
_comments.min_discharge_current/max_discharge_curr: Allowed V2G-current range in amperes; discharge values are non-positive.
_comments.n_ports: Number of EVs that can connect simultaneously.
_comments.charger_type: Charging interface type, normally AC or DC.
_comments.phases: Number of electrical phases used by the station.

_comments.schema: This area and its stations use the same fields documented under area_north.
